messages.subject: A little room for good ideas
messages.preview: The first sketches are ready. I kept the details quiet and gave everything a little more space.
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

The first sketches are ready. I kept the details quiet and gave everything a little more space.

There is a version for the smaller screens too. Take a look when you have a moment and let me know what feels right.

See you soon,
Alex
> On Monday, Sam wrote:
> Looking forward to seeing the next version.

messages.subject: Your week, a little clearer
messages.preview: A few things worth making time for. Notes from the studio, a new reading list, and an invitation.
messages.body:
A few things worth making time for.

Our studio is open next Thursday. Come along for a quiet afternoon of ideas and conversation.

messages.subject: Coffee on Thursday?
messages.preview: There is a new place by the park. Shall we say ten? No rush if your morning is busy.
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

There is a new place by the park. Shall we say ten?

No rush if your morning is busy.

Jamie

messages.subject: September project notes
messages.preview: A short update on the things we are making together. The new prototype is ready for a look.
messages.body:
The new prototype is ready for a look.

Please add your notes before Friday. We will talk through them together at the next studio meeting.

messages.subject: Take the longer way home
messages.preview: Small discoveries for a slower weekend. A walking route, a good book, and something to cook.
messages.body:
Small discoveries for a slower weekend.

Take the path by the river and stop at the old bookshop. There is always something new to find.

messages.subject: The first conversation

messages.body: Thanks for taking the time to chat yesterday. Looking forward to making this happen.
